value.rationale: Complete integral three-particle homology of the canonical 3-connected planar octahedral graph is a natural exact test of the planar degree-two generator/relations problem. The dimension 47 and its full 48-symmetry representation including a nontrivial central inversion split cannot be inferred from the previously known first-homology result or global generator theorem. This is a graph-specific, mathematically motivated classification without asserting a general theorem.
